string-array.name: month_quotes
string-array.item: "January: A fresh start is simply the next quiet breath you choose to take."
"February: Small acts of kindness, including toward yourself, add up."
"March: Growth is slow, and that is still growth."
"April: Let something new bloom at its own pace."
"May: Rest is productive. Give yourself room to recover."
"June: Step outside, slow down, and notice one good thing."
"July: You are allowed to take up space and take your time."
"August: Progress, not perfection, is the goal worth keeping."
"September: Begin again. Every day is a reasonable place to start."
"October: Change can be gentle. Let it be."
"November: Gratitude turns what you have into enough."
"December: Be as patient with yourself as you are with others."

string-array.item: "New: Dashboard now shows today's date and a quote for the month."
